thread:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach observed on /v1/generate (hosted) — rolling window 5m. p99 ~ 3.2s, baseline 450ms. Triggered by streaming monitor.
Anya: I'm on it. grabbing logs and looking at recent deploys. any recent infra changes?
Raj: I saw a config push 20m ago from CI: quant-profile:update -> applied int8-calib for redwood-large-v1 on hostpool-6.
Carlos: that was the calibration rollout we started tonight (int8 calibrated weights). I didn't expect it to affect tail like this but streaming path maybe hitting dequant path.
Support-Lead: we have two customer tickets opened for timeouts in the last 10m, both streaming clients. putting them on incident watch.
Anya: can someone post current p95/p99 numbers and streaming stall rate?
SRE-Bot: metrics snapshot (5m): p95=610ms, p99=3200ms, streaming_stalls=4.8% (baseline 0.3%). error-rate 0.4% (timeouts).
Raj: reproducing locally with a long context streaming request shows repeated stalls on chunk 3/4, KV fetch latency spikes. stack looks like dequant + KV merge wait.
Carlos: hypothesis: int8 calibration changed KV cache size/prefetch heuristics -> cache misses + fallback dequant path causes CPU blocking on host. also maybe kernel selection falling back to slower path for specific seq-len combos.
Anya: immediate mitigation options? rollback the quant-profile for that pool, or route streaming traffic to fp16 fallback model, or scale up hostpool.
Deploy-Bot: recent deploy 2073456700: quant-profile:update redwood-large-v1 -> int8-calib v2 -> applied to hostpool-6.
Raj: I can flip routing rule to route requests with streaming:true to model-variant fp16-fast for the next 30 minutes. That should avoid dequant path.
Anya: do it. also open a rollback PR for the quant-profile.
Raj: routing change applied: 
```
rictl route set --selector "route:/v1/generate and header:X-Streaming:true" --model redwood-large-v1-fp16 --reason "emergency streaming fallback"
```
Appended note: routes now showing 95% traffic to fp16 variant for streaming.
Carlos: I'm starting a roll-back of quant-profile on hostpool-6 to the previous profile (int8-calib v1). beginning now.
Deploy-Bot: rollback job queued 2073456910 -> started.
SRE-Bot: post-mitigation snapshot (2m after routing change): p99 down to 720ms, p95 580ms, streaming_stalls 0.6%. still watching.
Support-Lead: notified affected customers that we're investigating and put them on a status update cadence (10m).
Anya: good. assign on-call handoff in 30m to EngOncall for follow-up and RCA; I'm going to draft immediate incident summary.
Carlos: rollback job completed; quant-profile reverted on hostpool-6. I'm collecting calibration logs and quant stats. preliminary note: calibration optimizer changed per-layer scale heuristics for attention_kv which increased dequant CPU work by ~3-6x on certain sequence lengths.
Raj: also found a batching interaction: continuous batching timeout got increased in the profile which let very long requests accumulate and caused KV contention. lowered the batch timeout back to 20ms.
SRE-Bot: new metrics (5m): p99=530ms, p95=420ms, streaming_stalls=0.2%, error-rate 0.05%. Numbers trending to baseline.
EngOncall: taking over in 30m. will keep an eye on the canary and gather traces for the p99 tails.
Anya: notes for RCA: deploy path (quant-profile v2) -> calibration tweak (per-layer scales) -> increased dequant cost -> KV cache pressure -> streaming stalls -> p99 spikes. Immediate mitigations: routing->fp16, rollback profile, reduce batch timeout. Need longer-term: guardrails in calibration (perf regression tests), canary throttles, automatic rollback on SLO regressions.
Carlos: collecting artifact dump: calibration histograms, per-layer int8 scales, kernel selection logs, and perf counters. I'll upload to /mnt/incident/2073456789.
Support-Lead: will send customers a post-incident update once we have a short RCA.
Raj: adding alert to monitor to detect streaming_stalls > 1% for 3m and auto-route to fp16 variant. will file follow-up ticket.
Anya: thanks all. leaving a running timeline in the incident doc. tagging @EngOncall for handoff. I'll stay reachable for questions. :thumbsup:
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigated; watch mode active for 60m. escalation level: pager resolved.
EngOncall: acknowledged, will monitor for next 2 hours and start RCA runbook with Carlos + Raj.
summary: Emergency mitigation for p99 streaming latency after an int8 calibration rollout caused streaming stalls; routing fallback and rollback applied, metrics recovered; RCA and follow-ups assigned
